name: i am not your cat
source:
a bootleg doll abandoned on the playground whiles away the afternoon.

toys are meant to be played with, and girls are meant to be loved. so a girl unloved is the same as a doll on a shelf. sometimes i still think that i was made to be hurt by you.

[From [url=https://fablelustre.itch.io/not-your-cat]itch.io[/url]]
